name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Beacon, Ceres, and Diatoms belong to different colonists.
Ceres goes with at most two of Okafor, Pilot, and Lichen.
Forge goes with none of Cho, Captain, or Diatoms.
If Callisto goes with Captain, then Diatoms goes with Engineer.
Exactly one of these is true: Anders goes with Engineer; Cho goes with Basalt; Okafor goes with Echo.
Either Beacon goes with Engineer or Callisto goes with Anders.
Between Diatoms and Lichen, one goes with Anders and the other with Okafor.
